title: Tracker
subtitle: Your session record, live match and lobby ranks, and MMR from tracker.gg. Uses the game's own Stats API: nothing is injected.

setup.title: Tracker setup
setup.statsOn: Enabled in your game settings file. Restart the game if it was running.
setup.statsOff: The game's built-in match data feed (off by default).
setup.noConfig: Launch Rocket League once so it creates its user config folder.
setup.overlayHint: Small always-on-top window with your session and live score. Drag it anywhere.
setup.restartGame: The game does not answer: restart Rocket League so it reads the new setting.

session.title: Session
session.timelineEmpty: Finished matches appear here while the tracker is connected.
session.trackerOff: The Stats API is off: matches are not recorded.

stats.mmrHint: Set your profile in the MMR tab

mmr.title: MMR
mmr.empty: Enter your platform and ID to see your ranks.

off.title: Online ratings are off
off.body: MMR, ranks and lobby ranks come from tracker.gg's public pages (read by the app like a browser would). This is not an official API: turn it on only if you're fine with that. Nothing is sent except the player ids you look up.

lobby.title: Players in this match
lobby.source: Ranks from tracker.gg public profiles, matched with the ids the Stats API gives for each player.
